_comment: Route-A bare-host worker config (copy to sessions/_worker_config.json). pi is ONE engine profile (pi-api-container) at the same level as claude/codex/cursor — the default lineup's per-engine profiles are kept, only the roster selects what this host can actually run. Per-DIRECTION specialization is NOT a profile-multiplication problem: the worker image is already chosen per challenge category (worker_image_for_category → ctf-swarm-pi-<cat>), and future per-direction model/prompt hooks belong on the category machinery, not on the engine roster. Add claude/codex/cursor back to engines[] once their CLIs + credential accounts exist (sessions/_secrets/accounts/<engine>-main/API_KEY).
